title: Apostolic and Disciple Writings — Unified Historical Collection
ordering: Chronological by estimated composition date; overlapping ranges are not a claim of exact sequence.
scope: All identifiable writings connected by historical attribution, claim, tradition, subject, or early community use to apostles and disciples, including gospels, letters, testimony, acts, instruction, apocalypses, and other related writings. Inclusion is not an endorsement of authenticity, apostolic authorship, inspiration, or historical accuracy.
anti_compilation_rule: Do not use the later 27-writing compilation as the archive boundary or as the ordering template. Preserve its history as one later classification only.
date_policy: Store composition date estimates separately from physical witness dates. Where estimates overlap or are disputed, show a date band and mark sequence as approximate.
evidence_policy: Every entry must distinguish title tradition, actual author identification, date of composition, earliest surviving witness, manuscript text status, and historical reliability. Anonymous or pseudonymous works must not be presented as verified apostolic authorship.

records.title: Paul's Previous Letter to Corinth (referenced in 1 Corinthians 5:9)
records.date_precision: approximate; inferred from its reference before the extant 1 Corinthians; exact date unknown
records.attribution_status: Paul explicitly refers to a previous letter he had written to the Corinthian community; the writing itself is lost and its full contents cannot be recovered from the reference.
records.textual_status: Lost or unidentified; no independently identified manuscript witness or complete text is known. Do not reconstruct its wording from 1 Corinthians 5:9.
records.later_canonical_compilation_status: not part of the later 27-writing collection; historical classification only
records.chronology_basis: Relative sequence is supported by 1 Corinthians 5:9; calendar date is an estimate, not a manuscript date.

records.title: Paul's Sorrowful / Tearful Letter to Corinth
records.date_precision: approximate; placed between 1 Corinthians and the correspondence represented by 2 Corinthians; exact date debated
records.attribution_status: Paul refers to a letter written with distress and many tears; many scholars identify it as a separate lost letter, while some propose that material now in 2 Corinthians may preserve it.
records.textual_status: Not independently preserved as a complete identifiable writing. Possible identification with portions of 2 Corinthians 10–13 is disputed and must not be treated as established.
records.later_canonical_compilation_status: not part of the later 27-writing collection; historical classification only
records.chronology_basis: Relative sequence from 2 Corinthians 2:1–4 and 7:8–12; exact date and relationship to 2 Corinthians remain debated.
